item.title: perf(gateway): start macOS system-CA warmup before bootstrap (#128422)
item.summary: perf(gateway): start macOS system-CA warmup before bootstrap (#128422) Measured on this machine, the first boot after the OS trust cache went cold spent 4972ms in post-attach.system-ca; a fresh standalone Node process took 3529ms, while subsequent boots took 16-160ms. Start the single-flight warmup after kernel creation so the existing post-attach barrier observes only the residual wait.
